entries.name: struct.beam.area
entries.description: Get/set the cross-section area of the element.

entries.name: struct.beam.element.type
entries.description: Get the type of finite element used by this beam-type structural element. The finite-element types are euler-bernoulli and timoshenko.

entries.name: struct.beam.force
entries.description: Get the force at one end of the element. The force is expressed using the force-moment sign convention. See also the struct.force.nodal and struct.force.nodal.local functions.

entries.name: struct.beam.force.nodal
entries.description: Get the generalized nodal force acting at end iend in global system.

entries.name: struct.beam.force.x
entries.description: Get the x-component of the force at one end of the beam. The force is expressed using the force-moment sign convention.

entries.name: struct.beam.length
entries.description: Get the length of the element.

entries.name: struct.beam.load
entries.description: Get/set the uniform applied distributed load acting on the element in the local y-direction and z-direction (3D only).

entries.name: struct.beam.moi
entries.description: Get/set the moment of inertia of the beam.

entries.name: struct.beam.moi.x
entries.description: Get/set the x-component of the moment of inertia of the beam.

entries.name: struct.beam.moment
entries.description: Get the moment at one end of the element. The moment is expressed using the force-moment sign convention. See also the struct.force.nodal and struct.force.nodal.local functions.

entries.name: struct.beam.moment.plastic
entries.description: Get/set the plastic moment capacity in the beam. On assignment it sets the plastic moment limit in both the y and z directions. The return value is the maximum of the Y and Z limits.

entries.name: struct.beam.moment.plastic.y
entries.description: Get/set the plastic moment capacity in the beam in the beam system y direction.

entries.name: struct.beam.moment.plastic.z
entries.description: Get/set the plastic moment capacity in the beam system z direction.

entries.name: struct.beam.moment.x
entries.description: Get the x-component of the moment at one end of the beam. The moment is expressed using the force-moment sign convention.

entries.name: struct.beam.plastic
entries.description: Determine whether or not the beam-type element has a plastic material model. See the function struct.beam.model.

entries.name: struct.beam.plastic.iplocation
entries.description: Get the location of the integration point of a beam-type element with a plastic material model.

entries.name: struct.beam.plastic.ipstate
entries.description: Get plasticity state indicators at an integration point of an element with a plastic material model.

entries.name: struct.beam.plastic.ipstrain
entries.description: Get strain at integration point of a beam element with a plastic material model.

entries.name: struct.beam.plastic.ipstress
entries.description: Get stress at integration point of an element with a plastic material model.

entries.name: struct.beam.plastic.stress.bounds
entries.description: Gets the minimum (\sigma_{min}) and maximum (\sigma_{max}) axial stress within the element with a plastic material model (see the structure beam list plastic-stress-bounds (or pile) command).

entries.name: struct.beam.poisson
entries.description: Get/set the Poisson’s ratio of the beam element.

entries.name: struct.beam.prop
entries.description: This function provides the same behavior as the struct.prop function.

entries.name: struct.beam.prop.index
entries.description: This function provides the same behavior as the struct.prop.index function.

entries.name: struct.beam.volume
entries.description: Get the volume (cross-sectional area times the length) of the element.

entries.name: struct.beam.ydir
entries.description: Get/set the y-axis of the element local coordinate system.

entries.name: struct.beam.ydir.x
entries.description: Get/set the x-component of the y-axis of the beam element local system.

entries.name: struct.beam.young
entries.description: Get/set the Young’s modulus of the beam element.

entries.name: struct.cable.area
entries.description: Get/set the cross-section area of the cable element.

entries.name: struct.cable.force.axial
entries.description: Get the average axial force of the element (positive: tension; negative: compression).

entries.name: struct.cable.force.nodal
entries.description: Get the generalized nodal force acting at end iend.

entries.name: struct.cable.grout.cohesion
entries.description: Get/set the grout cohesion.

entries.name: struct.cable.grout.confining
entries.description: Get the confining stress acting on the grout at end iend ∈ {1, 2}.

entries.name: struct.cable.grout.dir
entries.description: Get the direction vector in which element is being loaded by the coupling spring at end iend ∈ {1, 2}.

entries.name: struct.cable.grout.dir.x
entries.description: Get the x-component of the direction vector in which element is being loaded by the coupling spring at end iend ∈ {1, 2}.

entries.name: struct.cable.grout.disp
entries.description: Get displacement in grout (shear coupling spring) at end iend ∈ {1, 2}; positive/negative with respect to the average axial direction of cable.

entries.name: struct.cable.grout.friction
entries.description: Get/set the grout internal friction angle.

entries.name: struct.cable.grout.perimeter
entries.description: Get/set the grout exposed perimeter.

entries.name: struct.cable.grout.slip
entries.description: Get the slip state of grout (shear coupling spring) at end iend ∈ {1, 2}. The return value {0, 1, 2} denotes never slipped, now slipping, or slipped in the past, respectively.

entries.name: struct.cable.grout.stiffness
entries.description: Get/set the grout stiffness.

entries.name: struct.cable.grout.stress
entries.description: Get stress in grout (shear coupling spring) at end iend ∈ {1, 2}; positive/negative with respect to average axial direction of the element.

entries.name: struct.cable.length
entries.description: Get the length of the element.

entries.name: struct.cable.prop
entries.description: This function provides the same behavior as the struct.prop function.

entries.name: struct.cable.prop.index
entries.description: This function provides the same behavior as the struct.prop.index function.

entries.name: struct.cable.slide
entries.description: Get the boolean flag of the large-strain sliding. If true, slide is on; if false, slide is off.

entries.name: struct.cable.slide.tol
entries.description: Get/set the large-strain sliding tolerance of the cable element.

entries.name: struct.cable.state.compression
entries.description: Get the compression yield state of the element. The return value {0, 1, 2} denotes never yielded, now yielding, or yielded in the past, respectively.

entries.name: struct.cable.state.tension
entries.description: Get the tension yield state of element. The return value {0, 1, 2} denotes never yielded, now yielding, or yielded in the past, respectively.

entries.name: struct.cable.strain.plastic
entries.description: Get the plastic tensile strain of the cable element.

entries.name: struct.cable.stress.axial
entries.description: Get the average axial stress of the element (positive: tension; negative: compression).

entries.name: struct.cable.tension.state
entries.description: Get/Set the applied tension state of the cable element. This is true if applied tension is active and false if it is not. The applied tension value is available struct.cable.tension.value.

entries.name: struct.cable.tension.value
entries.description: Get/Set the applied tension value of the cable element.

entries.name: struct.cable.volume
entries.description: Get the element volume (cross-sectional area times length).

entries.name: struct.cable.yield.compression
entries.description: Get/set the compression yield strength of the cable element.

entries.name: struct.cable.yield.tension
entries.description: Get/set the tension yield strength of the cable element.

entries.name: struct.cable.young
entries.description: Get/set the Young’s modulus of the cable element.

entries.name: struct.check
entries.description: Check that structures are of the same type.

entries.name: struct.connectivity
entries.description: Get the index of the node with component-ID id in the element. Will return 0 if no node in that element matches. The index ranges from 1 to the number of element nodes. See also struct.node.

entries.name: struct.delete
entries.description: Delete the structural element.

entries.name: struct.density
entries.description: Get/set the structural element density. This is used to determine gravitational forces and to determine nodal masses in dynamic mode.

entries.name: struct.dowel.force
entries.description: Get the shear force acting on the dowel.

entries.name: struct.dowel.orientation
entries.description: Get the orientation of the dowel. This is perpendicular to the joint or interface, and not necessarily parallel to the host hybrid bolt.

entries.name: struct.dowel.state
entries.description: Get the failure state of the dowel. Possible return values are

entries.name: struct.dowel.strain
entries.description: Get the shear strain in the dowel.

entries.name: struct.extra
entries.description: Get/set the FISH parameter value stored at index i of the extra array associated with the structural element.

entries.name: struct.find
entries.description: Get the structural element with internally assigned component-ID number i.

entries.name: struct.force.update
entries.description: Flags the cycling logic so that a geometry update is performed at the start of the next cycle.

entries.name: struct.geogrid.prop
entries.description: This function provides the same behavior as the struct.prop function.

entries.name: struct.geogrid.prop.index
entries.description: This function provides the same behavior as the struct.prop.index function.

entries.name: struct.geogrid.shear.cohesion
entries.description: Get/set the (shear) coupling spring cohesion strength of the geogrid element.

entries.name: struct.geogrid.shear.dir
entries.description: Get the direction (unit vector in global system) in which the geogrid element is being loaded by the shear coupling spring at node inode (inode ∈ {1, 2, 3}).

entries.name: struct.geogrid.shear.dir.x
entries.description: Get the x-component of the direction (unit vector in global system) in which the geogrid element is being loaded by the coupling spring at node inode (inode ∈ {1, 2, 3}).

entries.name: struct.geogrid.shear.disp
entries.description: Get the displacement in the shear coupling spring at node inode (inode ∈ {1, 2, 3}). Shear displacement is always positive and acts in the geogrid tangent plane. The shear direction is given by struct.geogrid.shear.dir.

entries.name: struct.geogrid.shear.friction
entries.description: Get/set the (shear) coupling spring friction angle of the geogrid element.

entries.name: struct.geogrid.shear.state
entries.description: Get the yield state of the shear coupling spring at node inode (inode ∈ {1, 2, 3}). Return a value i ∈ {1, 2, 3} denotes never yielded, yielding now, or yielded in the past, respectively.

entries.name: struct.geogrid.shear.stiffness
entries.description: Get/set the (shear) coupling spring stiffness of the geogrid element.

entries.name: struct.geogrid.shear.stress
entries.description: Get the stress in the shear coupling spring at node inode (inode ∈ {1, 2, 3}). Shear stress is always positive and acts in the geogrid tangent plane. The shear direction is given by struct.geogrid.shear.dir.

entries.name: struct.geogrid.slide
entries.description: Get/set the large-strain sliding flag. A true value denotes that the large-strain sliding is on.

entries.name: struct.geogrid.slide.tol
entries.description: Get/set the (shear) coupling spring slide tolerance of the geogrid element.

entries.name: struct.geogrid.stress.confining
entries.description: Get the confining stress at node inode (inode ∈ {1, 2, 3}). A negative value is compression. The confining stress is the stress component acting perpendicular to the geogrid surface.

entries.name: struct.group
entries.description: Get/set the group name assigned to structural element p in slot slot, if provided. The slot named 'Default' is used by default if slot is not provided.

entries.name: struct.group.remove
entries.description: Remove the group s from the structural element in any slot. The removal of s will only occur in slot, if provided.

entries.name: struct.head
entries.description: Get the first element in the list of all structural elements in the model.

entries.name: struct.hybrid.dowellist
entries.description: Get the list of dowels associated with this hybrid bolt element.

entries.name: struct.hybrid.orientation
entries.description: Get the orientation of the hybrid bolt element (vector along its axis)

entries.name: struct.hybrid.rupture.dowel
entries.description: Get the shear rupture state for the dowels associated with this hybrid bolt element. A return value of true indicates rupture due to shear strain exceeding the strain limit for ANY of the dowels associated with this element.

entries.name: struct.hybrid.rupture.tension
entries.description: Get the tensile rupture state for the element. true indicates rutpure due to tensile strain exceeding the strain limit.

entries.name: struct.id
entries.description: Get the structural element ID number. This is not to be confused with the component-ID number.

entries.name: struct.id.component
entries.description: Get the structural element component-ID number. This is a unique value assigned internally at creation, not to be confused with the ID number.

entries.name: struct.isgroup
entries.description: Check if the group s is associated with the structural element and return true if a match is found in any slot. The check for s will only occur in slot, if provided.

entries.name: struct.liner.embedded
entries.description: Get the embedded flag. A value of true denotes that the liner is embedded.

entries.name: struct.liner.normal.dir
entries.description: Get the direction (unit vector in global system) in which the liner element is being loaded by the normal coupling spring at node inode (inode ∈ {1, 2}).

entries.name: struct.liner.normal.dir.x
entries.description: Get the x-component of the direction (unit vector in global system) in which the liner element is being loaded by the normal coupling spring at node inode (inode ∈ {1, 2}).

entries.name: struct.liner.normal.disp
entries.description: Get the displacement of the normal coupling spring at node inode (inode ∈ {1, 2}). Normal displacement positive/negative implies separation/overlap. The normal direction is given by struct.liner.normal.dir.

entries.name: struct.liner.normal.stiffness
entries.description: Get/set the normal coupling spring stiffness of the liner element.

entries.name: struct.liner.normal.strength
entries.description: Get/set the normal coupling spring tensile strength of the liner element.

entries.name: struct.liner.normal.stress
entries.description: Get the stress magnitude in the normal coupling spring at node inode (inode ∈ {1, 2}).

entries.name: struct.liner.prop
entries.description: This function provides the same behavior as the struct.prop function.

entries.name: struct.liner.prop.index
entries.description: This function provides the same behavior as the struct.prop.index function.

entries.name: struct.liner.shear.cohesion
entries.description: Get/set the shear coupling spring cohesion of the liner element.

entries.name: struct.liner.shear.dir
entries.description: Get the direction (unit vector in global system) in which the liner element is being loaded by the shear coupling spring at node inode (inode ∈ {1, 2}).

entries.name: struct.liner.shear.dir.x
entries.description: Get the x-component of the direction (unit vector in global system) in which the liner element is being loaded by the shear coupling spring at node inode (inode ∈ {1, 2}).

entries.name: struct.liner.shear.disp
entries.description: Get the displacement in the shear coupling spring at node inode (inode ∈ {1, 2}). Shear displacement is always positive and acts in the liner tangent plane. The shear direction is given by struct.liner.shear.dir.

entries.name: struct.liner.shear.friction
entries.description: Get/set the shear coupling spring friction angle of the liner element.

entries.name: struct.liner.shear.residual
entries.description: Get/set the shear coupling spring residual cohesion of the liner element.

entries.name: struct.liner.shear.state
entries.description: Get the yield state of the shear coupling spring at node inode (inode ∈ {1, 2}). Return a value i ∈ {1, 2, 3} denotes never yielded, yielding now, or yielded in the past, respectively.

entries.name: struct.liner.shear.stiffness
entries.description: Get/set the shear coupling spring stiffness of the liner element.

entries.name: struct.liner.shear.stress
entries.description: Get the stress magnitude in the shear coupling spring at node inode (inode ∈ {1, 2}).

entries.name: struct.liner.slide
entries.description: Get/set the large-strain sliding flag. A true value denotes that the large-strain sliding is on.

entries.name: struct.liner.slide.tol
entries.description: Get/set the shear coupling spring slide tolerance of the liner element.

entries.name: struct.link.attach
entries.description: Get the attached condition used by the link in degree-of-freedom idof (from 1 to 6 (1 to 3 in 2D)).

entries.name: struct.link.delete
entries.description: Delete the structural link. The return value is ignored.

entries.name: struct.link.extra
entries.description: Get/set the FISH parameter value stored at index i of the extra array associated with the structural link.

entries.name: struct.link.find
entries.description: Get the link with internally assigned component-ID number i.

entries.name: struct.link.group
entries.description: Get/set the group name assigned to link p in slot slot, if provided. The slot named 'Default' is used by default if slot is not provided.

entries.name: struct.link.group.remove
entries.description: Remove the group s from the link in any slot. The removal of s will only occur in slot, if provided.

entries.name: struct.link.head
entries.description: Get the first zone in the list of all structural links in the model.

entries.name: struct.link.id
entries.description: Get the structural link ID number. This is defined as the ID number of the first element connected to the link host node and is not to be confused with the component-ID number.

entries.name: struct.link.id.component
entries.description: Get the structural link component-ID number. This is a unique value assigned internally at creation, not to be confused with the ID number.

entries.name: struct.link.isgroup
entries.description: Check if the group s is associated with the link and return true if a match is found in any slot. The check for s will only occur in slot, if provided.

entries.name: struct.link.list
entries.description: Get a pointer to the container of all structural links in the model.

entries.name: struct.link.maxid
entries.description: Get the maximum component-ID number assigned to any structural link in this model. The next link created will be assigned this value plus one.

entries.name: struct.link.model
entries.description: Get the name of the 1-D force-displacement model used in degree-of-freedom idof.

entries.name: struct.link.model.area
entries.description: Get/set the area associated with the force-displacement model. This is either returned as a 6×1 (3×1 in 2D) matrix or as a single value representing the area in degrees-of-freedom idof if provided.

entries.name: struct.link.model.compression
entries.description: Get/set the compressive yield force associated with the force-displacement model.

entries.name: struct.link.model.disp
entries.description: Get the relative displacement between the node and the target used by each 1-D force-displacement model.

entries.name: struct.link.model.force
entries.description: Get the current force in each 1-D force-displacement model.

entries.name: struct.link.model.gap
entries.description: Get/set the flag indicating whether gap calculations are active in the 1-D force-displacement model used in degree-of-freedom idof. See the struct.link.model.gap.neg and struct.link.model.gap.pos functions.

entries.name: struct.link.model.gap.neg
entries.description: Get/set the negative (compressive) gap component of each 1-D force-displacement model.

entries.name: struct.link.model.gap.pos
entries.description: Get the positive (tensile) gap component of each 1-D force-displacement model.

entries.name: struct.link.model.prop
entries.description: Get/set a property of the deformable model in degree-of-freedom idof in the structural elemenet link p.

entries.name: struct.link.model.stiffness
entries.description: Get/set the stiffness used by each 1-D force-displacement model.

entries.name: struct.link.model.tension
entries.description: Get/set the tensile yield force associated with the force-displacement model.

entries.name: struct.link.model.yield
entries.description: Get the yield state indicator in the 1-D force displacement model in degree-of-freedom idof. This is returned as an integer where 0 = never yielded, 1 = yielding now, and 2 = yielded in past.

entries.name: struct.link.next
entries.description: Get the next link after p in the list of all structural links in the model.

entries.name: struct.link.node
entries.description: Get a pointer to the node hosting the structural link.

entries.name: struct.link.num
entries.description: Get the total number of structural links in the model.

entries.name: struct.link.side
entries.description: Get the side number of the link. This may be a value from 1 to 16.

entries.name: struct.link.slide
entries.description: Get/set the large-strain sliding DR: previous wants to be a link to… where? flag for the link. This function only applies to node-to-zone links; it has no meaning for node-to-node links.

entries.name: struct.link.slide.tol
entries.description: Get/set the large-strain sliding DR: previous wants to be a link to… where? tolerance for the link. This function only applies to node-to-zone links; it has no meaning for node-to-node links.

entries.name: struct.link.target
entries.description: Get the ID (or component-ID) of the target. For a node-to-node link, this will the node component-ID number. For a node-to-zone link, this will be the zone ID number.

entries.name: struct.link.type
entries.description: Get the name of the link target type. A node-to-node link will return Structure Node. A node-to-zone link will return Zone.

entries.name: struct.link.typeid
entries.description: Get an identifier that uniquely determines the type of object. This function will return‭ 1283546109, indicating a general structural link.

entries.name: struct.link.used.by
entries.description: Get the name of the type of structural element with which this link is associated.

entries.name: struct.list
entries.description: Get a pointer to the list of all structural elements in the model, of any type.

entries.name: struct.local.system
entries.description: Get the local coordinate system for the structural element.

entries.name: struct.mark
entries.description: Get/set the mark flag on the structural element. The structural element logic may modify this flag during command processing and cycling.

entries.name: struct.maxid
entries.description: Get the maximum component-ID number assigned to any structural element in this model. The next element created will be assigned this value plus one.

entries.name: struct.mech.convergence
entries.description: Get the maximum convergence value (local ratio divided by target ratio) of all structural nodes in the model.

entries.name: struct.mech.ratio.avg
entries.description: Get the average convergence ratio of all structural nodes in the model.

entries.name: struct.mech.ratio.local
entries.description: Get the maximum local convergence ratio of all structural nodes in the model.

entries.name: struct.mech.ratio.max
entries.description: Get the ratio of maximum unbalanced force to average applied force of all structural nodes in the model.

entries.name: struct.name
entries.description: Get the name of a structure.

entries.name: struct.near
entries.description: Get the structural element (of any type) whose centroid is closest to the point v. Will return null if there are no structural elements in the model.

entries.name: struct.next
entries.description: Get the next element after p in the list of all structural elements in the model.

entries.name: struct.node
entries.description: Get a pointer to the node at index i in the structural element. See also struct.connectivity.

entries.name: struct.node.acc.global
entries.description: Get the generalized acceleration (expressed in the global coordinate system) of the structure node.

entries.name: struct.node.acc.local
entries.description: Get the generalized acceleration (expressed in the node-local system) of the structure node.

entries.name: struct.node.apply
entries.description: Get/set the generalized applied force expressed in a system defined by struct.node.apply.local (degree-of-freedom i ∈ {1, 2, … , 6} or {1, 2, 3} in 2D).

entries.name: struct.node.apply.local
entries.description: Get whether the coordinate system in which generalized applied forces are expressed is a local system.

entries.name: struct.node.convergence
entries.description: Returns the node convergence value, defined as the ratio of the current local force ratio (struct.node.ratio), to the target force ratio (struct.node.ratio.target). A value of 1 or less is therefore considered to be converged.

entries.name: struct.node.damp.local
entries.description: Get/set the local damping factor of the structure node.

entries.name: struct.node.disp.global
entries.description: Get the generalized displacement (expressed in the global coordinate system) of the structure node.

entries.name: struct.node.disp.local
entries.description: Get the generalized displacement (expressed in the node-local coordinate system) of the structure node.

entries.name: struct.node.dynamic.timestep
entries.description: Returns the critical dynamic timestep for this structure node as of the last time the node was updated when dynamic calculations were active. Will return zero if this isn’t calculated for any reason (e.g., slaved, fixed in all DOFs, etc.).

entries.name: struct.node.elements
entries.description: Get a list of all structural elements directly connected to this node.

entries.name: struct.node.extra
entries.description: Get/set the value stored in the ith extra variable array of structure node sn.

entries.name: struct.node.find
entries.description: Get the structure node with internally assigned component-ID number i.

entries.name: struct.node.fix
entries.description: Get/Set velocity-fixity flag expressed in the node-local system (degree-of-freedom component i1 ∈ {1, 2, … , 6} or {1, 2, 3} in 2D.

entries.name: struct.node.fix.local
entries.description: Get/set the fixity state of the node-local coordinate system. If free, then the system orientation will be set by the structural element that uses the node; if fixed, then the system orientation will remain fixed.

entries.name: struct.node.force.unbal.global
entries.description: Get the unbalanced force (expressed in the global coordinate system) of the structure node. The unbalanced force is the sum of all forces and moments acting on the node.

entries.name: struct.node.force.unbal.local
entries.description: Get the unbalanced force (expressed in the node-local coordinate system) of the structure node. The unbalanced force is the sum of all forces and moments acting on the node.

entries.name: struct.node.group
entries.description: Get/set the group name assigned to node sn in slot slot, if provided. The slot named 'Default' is used by default if slot is not provided.

entries.name: struct.node.group.remove
entries.description: Remove the group s from the node in any slot. The removal of s will only occur in slot, if provided.

entries.name: struct.node.head
entries.description: Get the first structure node in the list of all structure nodes.

entries.name: struct.node.id.component
entries.description: Get the structure node component-ID number. This is a unique value assigned internally at creation and is not to be confused with the ID number.

entries.name: struct.node.isgroup
entries.description: Check if the group s is associated with the node and return true if a match is found in any slot. The check for s will only occur in slot, if provided.

entries.name: struct.node.link
entries.description: Get the link associated with structure node sn. Returns null if no link is associated with the structure node.

entries.name: struct.node.list
entries.description: Get the pointer to the container of all structure nodes in the model.

entries.name: struct.node.mark
entries.description: Get/set the mark flag. Note that this flag may be modified during command processing, cycling, and plotting.

entries.name: struct.node.mass.added
entries.description: Get/set the extra mass in each degree of freedom addition to the inertial mass as a 1x6 (1x3 in 2D) matrix.

entries.name: struct.node.mass.local
entries.description: Get the mass at the degree-of-freedom i ∈ {1, 2, … , 6} ({1, 2, 3} in 2D) in the node-local system.

entries.name: struct.node.maxid
entries.description: Get the maximum component-ID number assigned to any structure node in the model. The next structure node created will be assigned this value plus one.

entries.name: struct.node.near
entries.description: Get the structure node nearest v. Will return null if there are no structure nodes in the model.

entries.name: struct.node.next
entries.description: Get the next structure node after sn in the list of all structure nodes in the model.

entries.name: struct.node.num
entries.description: Get the total number of structure nodes in the model.

entries.name: struct.node.pos
entries.description: Get the current position of the structure node.

entries.name: struct.node.pos.reference
entries.description: Get the reference position of the structure node. The reference position corresponds to the nodal position at the time that the stiffness matrices of all finite elements that use the node were formed.

entries.name: struct.node.pos.reference.x
entries.description: Get the x-component of the reference position vector for the structure node.

entries.name: struct.node.pos.x
entries.description: Get the x-component of the current position vector for the structure node.

entries.name: struct.node.ratio
entries.description: Get the local node mechanical convergence ratio. This is the ratio of unbalanced force to force applied to the node. See struct.node.convergence.

entries.name: struct.node.ratio.target
entries.description: Get/set the target mechanical force ratio in the node. The default value is 1e-4. A local force ratio (struct.node.ratio) below this value is considered converged. See struct.node.convergence.

entries.name: struct.node.resultant
entries.description: Get stress resultants (expressed in the surface coordinate system) that have been averaged for the shell-type elements that share this node.

entries.name: struct.node.stiff.local
entries.description: Get the stiffness (expressed in the node-local coordinate system) of the structure node.

entries.name: struct.node.surface.valid
entries.description: Get a boolean flag for surface coordinate system validity (true if the surface system is valid, false if it is not).

entries.name: struct.node.surface.xdir
entries.description: Get/set the orientation of the surface system of node sn such that the x-direction is aligned with the projection of the surface vector v onto the normal plane, which is defined by the z-direction.

entries.name: struct.node.system.local
entries.description: Get the orientation of the node-local coordinate system of the structure node. The return value can be a matrix if both i1 and i2 are omitted, a vector if both i1 is assigned but i2 is omitted, or a value if both i1 and i2 are assigned.

entries.name: struct.node.system.surface
entries.description: Get/set the orientation of the surface coordinate system of the structure node. The return value can be a matrix if both i1 and i2 are omitted, a vector if both i1 is assigned but i2 is omitted, or a value if both i1 and i2 are assigned.

entries.name: struct.node.temp.increment
entries.description: Get/set the temperature increment that will be applied to the structure node in the next timestep, causing structural elements connected to it to experience strains arising from thermal expansion.

entries.name: struct.node.typeid
entries.description: Get an identifier that uniquely determines the type of object. For a structure node, this will always return ‭1283546106‬. This can be used with the type.pointer.id intrinsic to identify the type of object to which a pointer refers.

entries.name: struct.node.vel.global
entries.description: Get the generalized velocity (expressed in the global coordinate system) of the structure node.

entries.name: struct.node.vel.local
entries.description: Get the generalized velocity (expressed in the node-local coordinate system) of the structure node.

entries.name: struct.num
entries.description: Get the total number of structural elements in the model.

entries.name: struct.pile.area
entries.description: Get/set the cross-section area of the pile element.

entries.name: struct.pile.axial.yield
entries.description: Get/set the axial tensile yield strength (force units) of the pile element.

entries.name: struct.pile.force
entries.description: Get the nodal force acting on the pile element at end iend ∈ {1, 2} in the element local system.

entries.name: struct.pile.force.nodal
entries.description: Get the generalized nodal force acting at end iend in the global system.

entries.name: struct.pile.force.x
entries.description: Get the x-component of the nodal force acting on the pile element at end iend ∈ {1, 2} in the element local system.

entries.name: struct.pile.gap
entries.description: Get the gap component in normal spring at end iend ∈ {1, 2} of the pile element.

entries.name: struct.pile.length
entries.description: Get/set the length of the pile element.

entries.name: struct.pile.load
entries.description: Get/set the uniform applied distributed load acting on the pile element in the local y- and z-directions.

entries.name: struct.pile.moi
entries.description: Get/set the moment of inertia of the pile.

entries.name: struct.pile.moi.x
entries.description: Get/set the x-component of the moment of inertia of the pile.

entries.name: struct.pile.moment
entries.description: Get the nodal moment acting on the pile element at end iend ∈ {1, 2} in the element local system.

entries.name: struct.pile.moment.plastic
entries.description: Get/set the plastic moment capacity of the pile element. On assignment it sets the plastic moment limit in both the y and z directions. The return value is the maximum of the Y and Z limits.

entries.name: struct.pile.moment.plastic.y
entries.description: Get/set the plastic moment capacity of the pile element in the element y direction.

entries.name: struct.pile.moment.plastic.z
entries.description: Get/set the plastic moment capacity of the pile element in the element z direction.

entries.name: struct.pile.moment.x
entries.description: Get the x-component of the nodal moment acting on the pile element at end iend ∈ {1, 2} in the element local system.

entries.name: struct.pile.normal.cohesion
entries.description: Get/set the normal coupling spring cohesive strength of the pile element.

entries.name: struct.pile.normal.dir
entries.description: Get the global direction in which the pile element is being loaded by the coupling normal spring at end iend ∈ {1, 2}.

entries.name: struct.pile.normal.dir.x
entries.description: Get the x-component of the global direction in which the pile element is being loaded by the coupling normal spring at end iend ∈ {1, 2}.

entries.name: struct.pile.normal.disp
entries.description: Get the displacement in the coupling normal spring at end iend ∈ {1, 2} of the pile element. Sign convention for normal spring is positive/negative, indicating separation/overlap.

entries.name: struct.pile.normal.friction
entries.description: Get/set the normal coupling spring friction angle of the pile element.

entries.name: struct.pile.normal.gap
entries.description: Get the normal coupling spring gap-use flag. A true value denotes gap is on, and a false value denotes gap is off.

entries.name: struct.pile.normal.state
entries.description: Get the yield state of the coupling normal spring at end iend ∈ {1, 2} of the pile element. Return value ∈ {0, 1, 2} denotes never yielded, now yielding, or yielded in the past, respectively.

entries.name: struct.pile.normal.stiffness
entries.description: Get/set the normal coupling spring stiffness of the pile element.

entries.name: struct.pile.normal.stress
entries.description: Get the stress in the coupling normal spring at end iend ∈ {1, 2} of the pile element. Sign convention for the normal spring is positive/negative, indicating separation/overlap.

entries.name: struct.pile.perimeter
entries.description: Get/set the exposed perimeter of the pile element.

entries.name: struct.pile.poisson
entries.description: Get/set the Poisson’s ratio of the pile element.

entries.name: struct.pile.prop
entries.description: This function provides the same behavior as the struct.prop function.

entries.name: struct.pile.prop.index
entries.description: This function provides the same behavior as the struct.prop.index function.

entries.name: struct.pile.rockbolt
entries.description: Get a boolean flag of the rockbolt. A true value denotes the rockbolt flag is on, and a false value denotes the rockbolt flag is off.

entries.name: struct.pile.rupture.tension
entries.description: Returns a boolean value indicating whether or not the rockbolt element has failed in tension

entries.name: struct.pile.shear.cohesion
entries.description: Get/set the shear coupling spring cohesive strength of the pile element.

entries.name: struct.pile.shear.dir
entries.description: Get the global direction in which the pile element is being loaded by the coupling shear spring at end iend ∈ {1, 2}.

entries.name: struct.pile.shear.dir.x
entries.description: Get the x-component of the global direction in which the pile element is being loaded by the coupling shear spring at end iend ∈ {1, 2}.

entries.name: struct.pile.shear.disp
entries.description: Get the displacement in coupling shear spring at end iend ∈ {1, 2} of the pile element. Sign convention for shear spring is positive/negative with respect to the average axial direction of pile.

entries.name: struct.pile.shear.flag
entries.description: Get the shear direction incremental confining stress flag. A true value denotes the flag is on, and a false value denotes the flag is off.

entries.name: struct.pile.shear.friction
entries.description: Get/set the shear coupling spring friction angle of the pile element.

entries.name: struct.pile.shear.state
entries.description: Get the yield state of the coupling shear spring at end iend ? {1, 2} of the pile element. Return a value ? {0, 1, 2} denote never yielded, now yielding, or yielded in the past, respectively.

entries.name: struct.pile.shear.stiffness
entries.description: Get/set the shear coupling spring stiffness of the pile element.

entries.name: struct.pile.shear.stress
entries.description: Get the stress in coupling shear spring at end iend ∈ {1, 2} of the pile element. Sign convention for shear spring is positive/negative with respect to the average axial direction of pile.

entries.name: struct.pile.slide
entries.description: Get a boolean flag of slide. A true value denotes the slide flag is on, and a false value denotes the slide flag is off.

entries.name: struct.pile.slide.tol
entries.description: Get/set the large-strain sliding tolerance of the pile element.

entries.name: struct.pile.state.compression
entries.description: Get the compression yield state of the pile element. The return value {0, 1, 2} denotes never yielded, now yielding, or yielded in the past, respectively.

entries.name: struct.pile.state.tension
entries.description: Get the tension yield state of pile element. The return value {0, 1, 2} denotes never yielded, now yielding, or yielded in the past, respectively.

entries.name: struct.pile.strain.failure
entries.description: Get/set the tensile failure strain (non-dimensional) of the pile element.

entries.name: struct.pile.stress.confining
entries.description: Get the confining stress at end iend ∈ {1, 2} of the pile element. (Negative value is compression.) Stress acts in a plane perpendicular to the pile axis; confining stress is the average of the principal values in this plane.

entries.name: struct.pile.table.cohesion
entries.description: Get/set the shear direction cohesion strength table number for the pile element.

entries.name: struct.pile.table.factor
entries.description: Get/set the shear direction friction table number for the pile element.

entries.name: struct.pile.table.friction
entries.description: Get/set the shear direction incremental confining stress factor table number for the pile element.

entries.name: struct.pile.tension.state
entries.description: Get/Set the applied tension state of the pile element. This is true if applied tension is active and false if it is not. The applied tension value is available struct.pile.tension.value.

entries.name: struct.pile.tension.value
entries.description: Get/Set the applied tension value of the pile element.

entries.name: struct.pile.volume
entries.description: Get/set the volume of the pile element.

entries.name: struct.pile.ydir
entries.description: Get/set the y-axis of the pile element local system.

entries.name: struct.pile.ydir.x
entries.description: Get/set the x-component of the y-axis of the pile element local system.

entries.name: struct.pile.yield.compression
entries.description: Get/set the axial compressive yield strength (force units) of the pile element.

entries.name: struct.pile.yield.tension
entries.description: Get/set the axial tensile yield strength (force units) of the pile element.

entries.name: struct.pile.young
entries.description: Get/set the Young’s modulus of the pile element.

entries.name: struct.pos
entries.description: Get the position vector of the element, defined as the element centroid.

entries.name: struct.pos.x
entries.description: Get the x-component of the position vector of the element, defined as the element centroid.

entries.name: struct.prop
entries.description: Get/set the value of a property in the structural element.

entries.name: struct.prop.index
entries.description: Returns the index of the property name in a structural element.

entries.name: struct.shell.area
entries.description: Get surface area of the shell element.

entries.name: struct.shell.beta
entries.description: Get/set shell-type material system beta angle. This is defined as the angle between the element local system x-axis and the material system x-axis. In radians measured counter-clockwise from the element local x-axis.

entries.name: struct.shell.depth.factor
entries.description: Get the depth factor at which stresses have been recovered.

entries.name: struct.shell.element.type
entries.description: Get the type of finite element used by this shell-type structural element. The finite-element types are cst, csth, dkt, dkt-cst, and dkt-csth.

entries.name: struct.shell.force.nodal
entries.description: Get the generalized nodal force acting on the shell at node index inode.

entries.name: struct.shell.model
entries.description: Get/set the shell constitutive model.

entries.name: struct.shell.plastic
entries.description: Determine whether or not the shell-type element has a plastic material model. See the function struct.shell.model.

entries.name: struct.shell.plastic.idata
entries.description: Get and set the integration point layout via the number of integration points through the thickness (N_t) and over the element area (N_a) for an element with a plastic material model.

entries.name: struct.shell.plastic.iplocation
entries.description: Get location of integration point of a shell-type element with a plastic material model.

entries.name: struct.shell.plastic.ipstate
entries.description: Get plasticity state indicators at integration point of an element with a plastic material model.

entries.name: struct.shell.plastic.ipstress
entries.description: Get stress at integration point of an element with a plastic material model.

entries.name: struct.shell.poisson
entries.description: Get/set the Poisson’s ratio of the element.

entries.name: struct.shell.pressure
entries.description: Get/set the uniform applied pressure acting on the shell. See also the structure shell apply command.

entries.name: struct.shell.prop
entries.description: This function provides the same behavior as the struct.prop function.

entries.name: struct.shell.prop.anis
entries.description: Get/set the anisotropic material properties as a list of 6 values.

entries.name: struct.shell.prop.index
entries.description: This function provides the same behavior as the struct.prop.index function.

entries.name: struct.shell.prop.matx
entries.description: Get/set the orthotropic/anisotropic material property x-direction.

entries.name: struct.shell.prop.ortho
entries.description: Get/set the orthotropic material properties as a list of 4 values.

entries.name: struct.shell.prop.type
entries.description: Get the material property type.

entries.name: struct.shell.resultant
entries.description: Get stress resultants (expressed in the surface coordinate system) at the location corresponding to iloc.

entries.name: struct.shell.resultant.valid
entries.description: Get stress resultant validity flag.

entries.name: struct.shell.stress
entries.description: Get stress for an element with an elastic material model (expressed in the global coordinate system with compression negative) at the depth defined by the current depth factor and at the location corresponding to iloc.

entries.name: struct.shell.stress.bounds
entries.description: Gets the minimum (\sigma_{min}) and maximum (\sigma_{max}) stress within the element (see the structure shell list stress-bounds (or liner/geogrid) command).

entries.name: struct.shell.stress.depth.factor
entries.description: Get the depth factor at which stresses for elements with an elastic material model have been recovered.

entries.name: struct.shell.stress.max
entries.description: Get the maximum stress of the element. This is the maximum principal stress of the fiber stress at depth +1 or -1, which is the combination of membrane and bending resultants.

entries.name: struct.shell.stress.min
entries.description: Get the minimum stress of the element. This is the minimum principal stress of the fiber stress at depth +1 or -1, which is the combination of membrane and bending resultants.

entries.name: struct.shell.stress.prin
entries.description: Get principal stresses for an element with an elastic material model at the depth defined by the current depth factor and at the location corresponding to iloc.

entries.name: struct.shell.stress.prin.x
entries.description: Get the x-component of the resolved principal stress at the current depth factor and position given by inode.

entries.name: struct.shell.stress.valid
entries.description: Get stress validity flag.

entries.name: struct.shell.stress.xx
entries.description: Get the xx-component of the stress tensor.

entries.name: struct.shell.thickness
entries.description: Get/set the element thickness.

entries.name: struct.shell.volume
entries.description: Get the shell volume (surface area times thickness).

entries.name: struct.shell.young
entries.description: Get/set the Young’s modulus of the element.

entries.name: struct.therm.expansion
entries.description: Get/set the thermal-expansion coefficient for the structural element.

entries.name: struct.type
entries.description: Get the name of the structural element type. This will be either beam, cable, pile, shell, geogrid, liner, hybrid or , dowel.

entries.name: struct.typeid
entries.description: Get an identifier that uniquely determines the type of object. This function will return ‭1283545601‬, indicating a general structural element.

entries.name: struct.was.updated
entries.description: Returns TRUE if the last validation check actually performed a geometry update.
